910.name: Pre-Classic Maya in Guatemala
910.description: Origins of Maya civilization in the Guatemalan highlands and Petén lowlands, monumental early cities.

sub_clusters.name: Early Maya Villages and Agriculture
sub_clusters.description: Transition from hunting-gathering to maize agriculture, early pottery, Pacific coast Soconusco influence.

sub_clusters.name: El Mirador — Preclassic Superpower
sub_clusters.description: Massive triadic pyramids (La Danta), largest pre-Classic city, extensive sacbé road network.

sub_clusters.name: Kaminaljuyú Highland Capital
sub_clusters.description: Major highland centre near modern Guatemala City, obsidian trade, Teotihuacan contacts.

sub_clusters.name: Nakbé and San Bartolo Murals
sub_clusters.description: Early monumental architecture, San Bartolo murals depicting Maya creation mythology.

920.name: Classic Maya Civilization in Guatemala
920.description: Golden age of Maya civilisation: Tikal, divine kingship, writing, astronomy, art, warfare.

sub_clusters.name: Tikal — Maya Superpower
sub_clusters.description: One of the largest Maya cities, Jasaw Chan K'awiil's defeat of Calakmul (695), Temple I and II.

sub_clusters.name: Tikal–Calakmul Star Wars
sub_clusters.description: Great Petén rivalry, Siyaj K'ahk' conquest (378), hegemonic struggle, emblem glyph politics.

sub_clusters.name: Quiriguá and Copán Rivalry
sub_clusters.description: Quiriguá's monumental stelae, victory over Copán's 18 Rabbit (738), finest zoomorph sculptures.

sub_clusters.name: Classic Maya Collapse in Petén
sub_clusters.description: Abandonment of major centres, population decline, drought, warfare, political fragmentation.

920.name: Post-Classic Highland Kingdoms
920.description: K'iche', Kaqchikel, Tz'utujil, and Mam kingdoms of the Guatemalan highlands after the lowland collapse.

sub_clusters.name: K'iche' Kingdom and Q'umarkaj
sub_clusters.description: Powerful highland kingdom, capital Q'umarkaj (Utatlán), Popol Vuh sacred text, warrior aristocracy.

sub_clusters.name: Kaqchikel Kingdom and Iximché
sub_clusters.description: Break from K'iche' dominance, capital Iximché, initial Spanish alliance.

930.name: Spanish Conquest of Guatemala
930.description: Pedro de Alvarado's brutal conquest, destruction of K'iche' and Kaqchikel kingdoms, colonial foundations.

sub_clusters.name: Alvarado's Invasion
sub_clusters.description: Pedro de Alvarado defeats K'iche' warriors, Battle of El Pinal, burning of Q'umarkaj, Kaqchikel alliance and betrayal.

sub_clusters.name: Tecún Umán and K'iche' Resistance
sub_clusters.description: Legendary K'iche' warrior-prince killed by Alvarado, national hero of Guatemala.

930.name: Captaincy General of Guatemala
930.description: Colonial administration of Central America from Antigua and later Nueva Guatemala, encomienda, missions, Bourbon reforms.

sub_clusters.name: Antigua Guatemala — Colonial Capital
sub_clusters.description: Santiago de los Caballeros (Antigua), Baroque splendour, earthquakes, relocation after 1773 Santa Marta quakes.

sub_clusters.name: Colonial Economy and Indigenous Society
sub_clusters.description: Encomienda, repartimiento, cochineal and indigo exports, Las Casas reforms, highland Maya survival.

sub_clusters.name: Bourbon Reforms and Creole Discontent
sub_clusters.description: Administrative centralisation, intendant system, economic liberalisation, independence sentiment.

940.name: Independence and Central American Federation
940.description: Independence from Spain, brief Mexican annexation, United Provinces of Central America, conservative-liberal wars.

sub_clusters.name: Independence Declaration (15 September 1821)
sub_clusters.description: Peaceful independence, Mexican Empire annexation, separation and federation formation.

sub_clusters.name: Federal Republic and Collapse
sub_clusters.description: Morazán's liberal federation, conservative opposition, cholera pandemic, Rafael Carrera rises.

940.name: Carrera and the Conservative Republic
940.description: Rafael Carrera's long conservative rule, church-state alliance, Indigenous populist base.

sub_clusters.name: Rafael Carrera's Rule
sub_clusters.description: First Indigenous-origin head of state, concordat with Rome, conservative order, president for life.

sub_clusters.name: Liberal Reform (Justo Rufino Barrios)
sub_clusters.description: Liberal revolution, coffee expansion, forced Indigenous labour, church disestablishment, centralisation.

940.name: Coffee Dictatorship Era
940.description: Liberal dictators, coffee monoculture, United Fruit Company, forced labour, Ubico dictatorship.

sub_clusters.name: Estrada Cabrera Dictatorship
sub_clusters.description: 22-year dictatorship, United Fruit Company concessions, 1917-18 earthquakes, overthrow.

sub_clusters.name: Jorge Ubico Dictatorship
sub_clusters.description: Vagrancy laws forcing Indigenous labour, pro-US alignment, modernisation, repression, overthrow in 1944.

950.name: October Revolution and Guatemalan Spring
950.description: Democratic revolution, Arévalo and Árbenz reforms, land reform (Decree 900), CIA coup.

sub_clusters.name: October Revolution (1944)
sub_clusters.description: Student-military uprising, democratic constitution, Juan José Arévalo's spiritual socialism.

sub_clusters.name: Árbenz and Agrarian Reform (Decree 900)
sub_clusters.description: Jacobo Árbenz expropriates idle United Fruit lands, threatens US corporate interests.

sub_clusters.name: CIA Coup (Operation PBSUCCESS)
sub_clusters.description: CIA-backed overthrow of Árbenz, Castillo Armas installed, reversal of reforms, Cold War precedent.

950.name: Guatemalan Civil War
950.description: 36-year internal conflict, counterinsurgency, scorched earth, Ixil genocide, 200,000 killed.

sub_clusters.name: Guerrilla Insurgency
sub_clusters.description: FAR, EGP, ORPA, PGT insurgent groups, rural and Indigenous base, urban repression.

sub_clusters.name: Ríos Montt and Ixil Genocide
sub_clusters.description: Scorched-earth campaign, 626 massacres documented, 83% of victims Indigenous Maya, genocide conviction (2013).

sub_clusters.name: Peace Accords (1996)
sub_clusters.description: Accord for a Firm and Lasting Peace, URNG demobilisation, truth commission (CEH), Menchú Nobel (1992).

960.name: Post-Conflict Guatemala
960.description: Fragile democracy, organised crime, impunity, CICIG anti-corruption commission, social inequality.

sub_clusters.name: Post-Conflict Challenges
sub_clusters.description: Slow peace implementation, land reform stalled, lynchings, Portillo corruption, gang violence.

sub_clusters.name: CICIG Anti-Corruption Commission
sub_clusters.description: UN-backed CICIG exposes corruption networks, Pérez Molina arrest (2015), La Línea scandal.

sub_clusters.name: Maya Cultural Revival
sub_clusters.description: Maya language revitalisation, Indigenous rights movement, traditional authority systems, cultural pride.

960.name: Contemporary Guatemala
960.description: Democratic backsliding, migration crisis, Giammattei era, Arévalo election victory (2023), Fuego eruption.

sub_clusters.name: Migration Crisis and Caravans
sub_clusters.description: Mass migration to the US, migrant caravans, root causes: poverty, violence, climate change.

sub_clusters.name: Volcán de Fuego Eruption
sub_clusters.description: Pyroclastic flows kill 190+ in San Miguel Los Lotes, government response failures.

sub_clusters.name: Bernardo Arévalo Election (2023)
sub_clusters.description: Surprise anti-corruption candidate wins presidency, attempts to block inauguration, democratic hope.

unassigned_events.note: Events not yet assigned to a thematic cluster
